case_resolution.name: Case Resolution
case_resolution.query:
dataset = cases
| filter xdm.case.status_progress = ENUM.RESOLVED
| filter xdm.case.name contains "Case Name Part Here"
| comp earliest(_insert_time) as create_time, latest(resolution_time) as resolution_time, latest(xdm.case.status_progress) as xdm.case.status_progress by xdm.case.id
| alter resolution_time = to_timestamp(resolution_time, "MILLIS")
| alter duration = timestamp_diff(resolution_time, create_time, "MINUTE")
| limit 100000

issue_resolution.name: Issue Resolution
issue_resolution.query:
dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name contains "Issue Name Part Here"
| filter xdm.issue.resolution_timer != null
| filter json_extract_scalar(xdm.issue.resolution_timer, "$.runStatus") = "ended"
| alter start_date = json_extract_scalar(xdm.issue.resolution_timer, "$.startDate")
| alter end_date = json_extract_scalar(xdm.issue.resolution_timer, "$.endDate")
| alter create_time = parse_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", start_date)
| alter resolution_time = parse_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", end_date)
| alter duration = divide(to_integer(json_extract_scalar(xdm.issue.resolution_timer, "$.totalDuration")), 60)
| fields xdm.issue.id, create_time, resolution_time, duration, xdm.issue.status.progress

playbook_run_performance_rollup.name: Playbook Run Performance
playbook_run_performance_rollup.query:
dataset = playbook_runs
| alter xdm.issue.id = to_integer(entity_id)
| join type=inner (
    dataset = issues
    | filter xdm.issue.name contains "Issue Name Part Here"
  ) as issue_link xdm.issue.id = to_integer(issue_link.xdm.issue.id)
| alter net_duration_sec = divide(to_integer(net_duration), 1000)
| alter run_time_sec = divide(to_integer(run_time), 1000)
| comp count() as run_count,
       count_distinct(xdm.issue.id) as issue_count,
       sum(if(playbook_status = "failed", 1, 0)) as failed_count,
       sum(if(playbook_status = "completed", 1, 0)) as completed_count,
       avg(net_duration_sec) as avg_net_duration_sec,
       median(net_duration_sec) as median_net_duration_sec,
       min(net_duration_sec) as min_net_duration_sec,
       max(net_duration_sec) as max_net_duration_sec,
       avg(run_time_sec) as avg_run_time_sec,
       median(run_time_sec) as median_run_time_sec,
       min(run_time_sec) as min_run_time_sec,
       max(run_time_sec) as max_run_time_sec
  by playbook_name, playbook_id, entity_trigger_type, is_sub_playbook, parent_playbooks
| alter failure_rate = divide(failed_count, run_count)
| sort desc failure_rate, desc avg_net_duration_sec

playbook_task_performance_rollup.name: Playbook Task Performance
playbook_task_performance_rollup.query:
dataset = playbook_tasks
| alter xdm.issue.id = to_integer(entity_id)
| join type=inner (
    dataset = issues
    | filter xdm.issue.name contains "Issue Name Part Here"
  ) as issue_link xdm.issue.id = to_integer(issue_link.xdm.issue.id)
| alter duration_sec = divide(to_integer(duration), 1000)
| alter retry_count = to_integer(retry_count)
| alter size = to_integer(size)
| comp count() as task_run_count,
       count_distinct(xdm.issue.id) as issue_count,
       sum(if(task_status = "Error", 1, 0)) as error_count,
       sum(if(task_status = "Completed", 1, 0)) as completed_count,
       avg(duration_sec) as avg_duration_sec,
       median(duration_sec) as median_duration_sec,
       min(duration_sec) as min_duration_sec,
       max(duration_sec) as max_duration_sec,
       avg(retry_count) as avg_retry_count,
       max(retry_count) as max_retry_count,
       sum(retry_count) as total_retries,
       avg(size) as avg_size,
       max(size) as max_size
  by task_id, task_name, task_playbook_id, type, script_id, script_name
| alter error_rate = divide(error_count, task_run_count)
| sort desc error_rate, desc avg_duration_sec

playbook_task_errors.name: Playbook Task Errors
playbook_task_errors.query:
dataset = playbook_tasks
| filter task_status = "Error"
| alter xdm.issue.id = to_integer(entity_id)
| join type=inner (
    dataset = issues
    | filter xdm.issue.name contains "Issue Name Part Here"
  ) as issue_link xdm.issue.id = to_integer(issue_link.xdm.issue.id)
| join type=left (
    dataset = case_to_issue
  ) as case_link xdm.issue.id = to_integer(case_link.xdm.issue.id)
| fields xdm.issue.id, xdm.case.id, xdm.issue.name, task_id, task_name, task_status, script_name, automated, duration, retry_count, error, errors, start_date, _time
